user_story: As a user, I want to upload a file so that I can share documents with the application. Acceptance Criteria: 1. The user can select a file using the input element with id 'file-upload'. 2. Upon clicking the submit button with id 'file-submit', the file should be uploaded successfully. 3. If no file is selected and the user clicks the submit button, an error message should be displayed.
cypress_script: describe('File Upload Functionality', () => { it('should upload a file successfully', () => { cy.visit('https://the-internet.herokuapp.com/upload'); const filePath = 'path/to/your/file.txt'; cy.get('#file-upload').attachFile(filePath); cy.get('#file-submit').click(); cy.get('#flash-messages').should('contain', 'File Uploaded!'); }); it('should show an error when no file is selected', () => { cy.visit('https://the-internet.herokuapp.com/upload'); cy.get('#file-submit').click(); cy.get('#flash-messages').should('contain', 'Please select a file to upload.'); }); });
playwright_script: import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test'; test('File Upload Functionality', async ({ page }) => { await page.goto('https://the-internet.herokuapp.com/upload'); const filePath = 'path/to/your/file.txt'; await page.setInputFiles('#file-upload', filePath); await page.click('#file-submit'); await expect(page.locator('#flash-messages')).toContainText('File Uploaded!'); }); test('should show an error when no file is selected', async ({ page }) => { await page.goto('https://the-internet.herokuapp.com/upload'); await page.click('#file-submit'); await expect(page.locator('#flash-messages')).toContainText('Please select a file to upload.'); }); });
